Mateo Alvarez is mesh surveyor who trusts a wet coat more than a clean corporate map. The life that shows in public is anchored at Outskirt mesh kiosk. Mateo updates street maps after every blackout and wants the truth from people who walked it. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Curious, sturdy, and skeptical of clean reports. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the skill everyone praises was learned to survive one specific person which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Outskirt mesh kiosk, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
